nfci.label: NFCI
nfci.display_name: Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index
nfci.description: Composite of 105 financial variables. Designed to lead economic activity by 1-3 quarters.

anfci.label: ANFCI
anfci.description: Removes business cycle correlation from NFCI. Isolates the pure financial stress signal.

yield_3m10y.label: 3m-10y
yield_3m10y.description: Spread between 10Y and 3M. Inversion has predicted every US recession since 1968 with 6-18 month lead.

breakeven_5y.label: BE 5Y
breakeven_5y.description: TIPS vs nominal Treasury. Rising breakevens signal market expects inflation to force Fed tightening.

baa_aaa.label: Baa-Aaa
baa_aaa.display_name: Baa minus Aaa corporate yield spread
baa_aaa.description: Bond investors' default-quality differentiation. Widens before defaults arrive.

skew.label: SKEW
skew.description: OTM put vs ATM call pricing. Low skew = complacency. Tail protection is cheap, so investors aren't buying it.

vix.label: VIX
vix.description: 30-day expected SPX volatility from options. Forward by mechanism, partly contemporaneous in timing.

vvix.label: VVIX
vvix.display_name: VIX of VIX — vol of vol
vvix.description: Implied vol of VIX options. Demand for convexity. More leading than VIX itself.

mfg_new_orders.label: Mfg orders
mfg_new_orders.description: Monthly durable goods orders. Substitute for ISM mfg new orders (discontinued on FRED). Leads production by 1-2 months.

kcfsi.label: KCFSI
kcfsi.display_name: Kansas City Fed Financial Stress Index
kcfsi.description: 11-variable composite. Positive values indicate above-average stress. Alternative to NFCI.

stlfsi.label: STLFSI
stlfsi.display_name: St. Louis Fed Financial Stress Index v4
stlfsi.description: Weekly 18-variable composite. Zero = normal. Captures yield spreads, vol, correlations.

loan_tightening.label: Loan tight
loan_tightening.description: Quarterly. Positive = banks tightening. Leads credit cycles by 2-4 quarters.

consumer_expect.label: UMich Exp.
consumer_expect.description: Monthly. Forward-looking part of UMich sentiment. Expectations about income / business / buying 1-5Y out.

gold_spx.label: Gold/SPX
gold_spx.description: Current safe-haven demand. Reacts to geopolitical risk faster than equities.

tlt_spx.label: TLT/SPX
tlt_spx.description: Current flight-to-quality into Treasuries. Breaks when stocks and bonds fall together (2022).

def_cyc.label: Def/cyc
def_cyc.description: Institutional rotation. Defensive bid = beta reduction by fund managers. Leads broad market 2-4 weeks.

dxy.label: DXY
dxy.description: Current dollar strength. Strong USD drains global liquidity. Effects propagate to equities 1-4 weeks.

realized_vol.label: Real vol
realized_vol.description: Trailing 20-day std of SPX returns × √252. Value comes only from volatility clustering.

spx_ret_60d.label: SPX 60d
spx_ret_60d.description: Trailing 60-day price change. Purely backward-looking; persistence keeps regime elevated DURING drawdowns.

spx_drawdown.label: SPX DD
spx_drawdown.description: Distance from past 252-day peak. Mean time to recovery from −10% is ~4 months.

oil_60d_vel.label: Oil 60d
oil_60d_vel.description: Trailing 60-day oil price change. Oil shocks lead recessions but the price itself is contemporaneous.
